title: Diretor Escolar
description:
Este cargo estará localizado em uma escola no Brasil; não é remoto.


Com a expansão da International Schools Partnership pel, buscamos Diretores, Vice-diretores e Líderes Seniores com sólida experiência em educação K-12 e histórico comprovado de melhoria escolar. Procuramos líderes apaixonados pela Excelência Acadêmica , com visão operacional e mentalidade comercial para gerir escolas de alto desempenho.

Junte-se a uma rede global dedicada a fortalecer líderes escolares, promover inovação e transformar positivamente comunidades educacionais em toda a região.


Sobre a International Schools Partnership

A International Schools Partnership é um grupo global em crescimento, com 114 escolas internacionais privadas em 25 países, atendendo mais de 92.500 estudantes.

Nossa missão é apoiar nossas escolas para que se tornem a principal escolha em suas comunidades, estabelecendo novos padrões de qualidade, preparando estudantes para o futuro e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das comunidades onde atuam.


Por que construir sua carreira na International Schools Partnership?

  • Visão Global: Atue em um ambiente que valoriza a perspectiva internacional e a diversidade cultural.
  • Compromisso com a Excelência: Faça parte de um grupo focado em ensino e aprendizagem de alta qualidade.
  • Ambientes Modernos: Trabalhe em instalações inovadoras e bem equipadas.
  • Desenvolvimento em Liderança: Tenha acesso a formação contínua e oportunidades de crescimento global.


Propósito do Cargo

O Diretor lidera com visão e integridade, construindo uma cultura escolar segura, inclusiva e colaborativa onde o aprendizado prospera. Em parceria com sua equipe, famílias e a rede International Schools Partnership, posiciona a escola como uma “Escola de Escolha”, garantindo experiências e resultados acadêmicos excepcionais, impulsionando matrículas e retenção. Suas responsabilidades incluem salvaguarda, melhoria do ensino baseada em evidências, planejamento estratégico, engajamento da comunidade e desempenho comercial.

O Diretor se reporta ao Diretor Regional (RMD).


Responsabilidades-Chave

(Com peso igual de 25% cada)

  • Desenvolvimento e bem-estar da equipe
  • Resultados de aprendizado dos estudantes
  • Engajamento comunitário e experiência das famílias
  • Desempenho comercial


Competências-Chave

Planejamento estratégico, liderança educacional, gestão de proteção infantil, liderança inclusiva, inteligência emocional, construção de comunidade, engajamento de stakeholders, desenvolvimento de equipes, gestão de desempenho, comunicação eficaz, tomada de decisão baseada em dados, marketing educacional, finanças, gestão de mudança e colaboração.

title: Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho
description:
Tarefas.

  • Realizar atendimentos ambulatoriais (curativos, aferições, administração de medicamentos) e apoiar o Médico do Trabalho nas rotinas do ambulatório;
  • Controlar diariamente medicamentos, materiais e equipamentos médico-hospitalares, incluindo verificação das bolsas de primeiros socorros;
  • Agendar e acompanhar exames ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, demissionais, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função);
  • Registrar e controlar atestados, afastamentos e situações de saúde dos colaboradores;
  • Auxiliar na investigação de acidentes, abertura de CAT e acompanhamento dos casos;
  • Participar da integração de novos colaboradores e apoiar campanhas de saúde, SIPAT e demais ações preventivas;
  • Apoiar o cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR-7, NR-32, NR-1), realizar visitas domiciliares ou hospitalares quando necessário, e executar demais atividades inerentes à função atendendo aos padrões de qualidade, saúde, segurança, meio ambiente e eficiência energética estabelecidos pela companhia.


Perfil.

  • Curso completo em Técnico de Enfermagem do Trabalho;
  • Registro no Órgão Profissional (COREN);
  • Pacote Office básico;
  • Conhecimento no sistema Sênior será um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no 2º turno


Benefícios.

  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Prêmio Assiduidade - Vale-alimentação Sodexo;
  • PPR;
  • Convênio com farmácia;
  • Transporte;
  • Alimentação na empresa subsidiada com refeitório próprio.

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
Senior Java Developer – Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Java Developer to join our team and lead the modernization of our existing applications. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Java development, hands-on experience with modern frameworks, and the ability to guide the migration of legacy systems to contemporary architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the migration of legacy applications (currently built on Struts 2.0 ) to modern frameworks and architectures.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable applications using Java , Spring Framework , and Microservices .
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define technical requirements, propose solutions, and deliver high-quality software.
  • Participate in the full SDLC including analysis, design, coding, testing, and deployment.
  • Ensure code quality through best practices such as code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to design patterns.
  • Support and troubleshoot production issues, ensuring application stability and performance.
  • Work on frontend components as needed using React or Angular (added advantage).
  • Leverage Python skills for automation, data processing, or backend scripting tasks (bonus).
  • Mentor junior developers and contribute to improving overall team capability and processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6–10+ years of experience in Java/J2EE development .
  • Strong hands-on experience in Spring Boot , Spring MVC , Microservices , REST APIs, and related technologies.
  • Experience with Struts 2.0 or legacy frameworks and proven ability to migrate systems to modern architectures.
  • Good understanding of software design principles, OOP, design patterns , and best coding practices.
  • Experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps concepts.
  • Working knowledge of React or Angular (good to have).
  • Basic to intermediate experience with Python (bonus).

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Program Manager/Delivery Manager

Duration: Fulltime with CriticalRiver

Location: Brazil/Costa Rica

Need to support PST timings

Job Profile:

  • Manage delivery for our key customers across all the technological tracks
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Ensure regular updates to customer stake holders sent through WSRs
  • Conduct MBRs and QBRs
  • Achieve high customer delight


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and budget by working with technology teams.
  • Work closely with customer stake holders and ensure the project scope is well understood and documented as per the defined standards
  • Manage and lead teams across technologies, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
  • Work with PMO and ensure quality control procedures to ensure high standards in the delivery.
  • Act as a delivery point of contact for Customer, Understanding the Customer, managing expectations and ensuring highest customer satisfaction.
  • Service/Project Review meetings with Customer and Management
  • Adopt customer specific processes and methodologies.
  • Proactively Identify, evaluate, and mitigate project risks effectively.
  • Ensure that the project teams meet SLAs and avoid service credits / penalties.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery processes, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Utilize effective conflict resolution and negotiation tactics to maintain high-level performance within service teams.
  • Establish and monitor KRAs and KPIs as performance metrics for team members.
  • Support hiring the right resources for various tracks as the roles get identified by working with the TAG teams
  • Ensure SOWs are signed and Invoices cleared on-time by working with finance teams and the customer stakeholders
  • Continuously work with individual members in the project teams and ensure their contributions are made visible to customer in terms of activities/stories/Jira Tickets as applicable on a weekly basis and obtain continuous feedback on the performance of the teams and course correct as needed appropriately.
  • Work with customer stake holders, identify the opportunities, proactively create proposals with efforts, solutioning and financials


Skills:

  • Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Proven experience in software development project management, must have worked with onshore/Nearshore/offshore model. Open to be flexible to be able to speak to teams in different time zones.
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, thought leadership skills with the ability to effectively engage with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Familiarity with various project management tools and methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, ITIL).
  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to manage complex project challenges

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Appointment Setter - Fully Remote

About the Job:

We are looking for someone who will be setting appointments with leads, has great written and spoken English skills, has attention to detail and organizational skills.

You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us set appointments for our clients' leads. title: Chef Tournant
description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
  • Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
  • Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
  • Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
  • Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
  • Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
  • Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
  • Responsible for follow-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
  • Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
  • Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
  • Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
  • Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
  • Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
  • Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food & Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
  • Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.


QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION

  • A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
  • A culinary school degree is required.
  • Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
  • Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
  • Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
  • Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
  • Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
  • Intermediate computer software skills required.
  • Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
  • Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

title: Backend Developer
description:
The professional will work primarily in the Conversion Squad, responsible for lead acquisition flows and marketing forms — a high‑impact and business‑critical area at Creditas.

The main focus will be Back-end development using Kotlin + Spring Boot.


The developer may also support small tasks in Front-end/BFF applications built with Next.js and Node.js, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams.


Responsibilities


  • Develop Back-end solutions ensuring functionality, maintainability, performance, and adherence to engineering best practices.
  • Build services aligned with business strategy, OKRs, and product initiatives.
  • Implement and maintain reliable and scalable microservices and REST APIs.
  • Create automated tests following the testing pyramid.
  • Work in a collaborative environment with pair programming and a strong feedback culture.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively in daily meetings, agile ceremonies, and when raising blockers.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement within the Conversion Squad projects.



Competencies


  • Strong and active communication — especially during daily meetings.
  • Proactive attitude in raising issues, proposing solutions, and seeking support when needed.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering).
  • Organization and strong sense of ownership over deliverables.
  • Hard Skills — Mandatory (Must Have):
  • Proficiency in Kotlin and Spring Boot (top priority).
  • Solid experience with microservices and REST API architecture.
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases.
  • Experience with automated testing and understanding of the testing pyramid.
  • Experience with at least one other Back-end language: Java, Python, Ruby, Go (Kotlin is mandatory).
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).


Nice to Have:


  • Experience with modern Front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js).
  • Knowledge of BFF using Node.js.
  • Experience with messaging tools (Kafka, AWS SQS, etc.).
  • Knowledge of Clean Code and Design Patterns.


Skill Set


  • Kotlin + Spring Boot
  • Microservices & Distributed Architecture
  • REST APIs
  • Relational Databases
  • Automated Testing

title: Data Analyst
description:
Since 1995, Red Oak Technologies has been a trusted partner in the tech industry, delivering innovative talent solutions that drive progress. We specialize in quickly acquiring and efficiently matching top-tier professional talent with clients in immediate need of highly skilled contract, permanent or project management based resources.


Data Analyst, Sales Finance


Location: LATAM- BRAZIL OR MEXICO

Hours: 40 hours per week

Duration: 1 year contract


About the Role and Team

Our Client is seeking a Data Analyst (Contractor) to support the Sales Finance team. This role will help accelerate analysis, reporting, and business insights by partnering closely with the Senior Manager of Sales Finance Analytics. You will work on a mix of ad hoc analysis, deep dive projects, dashboard and BI development, and light data engineering in support of Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.


This is a hands-on execution role focused on delivering high quality analytical work that helps the company move faster. The ideal candidate has moderate SQL skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.


Projects and Initiatives You Will Support

  • Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions related to customer behavior, product usage, sales performance, and financial trends
  • Support deep dive projects such as weighted pipeline evaluation, consumption reporting, sales attainment analysis, and LTV to CAC modeling
  • Build and maintain draft BI dashboards in Tableau or similar tools
  • Write SQL queries to pull, clean, and transform data in Snowflake
  • Support the development of repeatable data models for financial and operational metrics
  • Draft summaries and written analysis that highlight insights and trends
  • Partner with internal teams to clarify metric definitions and ensure consistency across reporting
  • Document logic, definitions, and assumptions to support long term reuse
  • You Will Be a Great Addition to the Team If You Have


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a related field
  • Moderate SQL experience with a willingness to learn and improve
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to connect data to business concepts
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to summarize findings
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in an async environment
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving


Extra skills that stand out:


  • A builder mentality with interest in creating small tools or solutions to improve workflows. Curiosity and experimentation with AI tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline, product usage, or LTV to CAC
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Experience supporting finance, revenue, or business operations teams
  • Knowledge of Python or scripting for data automation is helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with data modeling or ELT concepts
  • Contract Structure

We specialize in quickly acquiring and efficiently matching top-tier professional talent with clients in immediate need of highly skilled contract, permanent or project management based resources.


Data Analyst, Sales Finance


Location: LATAM- BRAZIL OR MEXICO

Hours: 40 hours per week

Duration: 1 year contract


About the Role and Team

Our Client is seeking a Data Analyst (Contractor) to support the Sales Finance team. This role will help accelerate analysis, reporting, and business insights by partnering closely with the Senior Manager of Sales Finance Analytics. You will work on a mix of ad hoc analysis, deep dive projects, dashboard and BI development, and light data engineering in support of Finance, Sales, Marketing, and Product teams.


This is a hands-on execution role focused on delivering high quality analytical work that helps the company move faster. The ideal candidate has moderate SQL skills, strong business acumen, and the ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.


Projects and Initiatives You Will Support

  • Run ad hoc analysis to answer business questions related to customer behavior, product usage, sales performance, and financial trends
  • Support deep dive projects such as weighted pipeline evaluation, consumption reporting, sales attainment analysis, and LTV to CAC modeling
  • Build and maintain draft BI dashboards in Tableau or similar tools
  • Write SQL queries to pull, clean, and transform data in Snowflake
  • Support the development of repeatable data models for financial and operational metrics
  • Draft summaries and written analysis that highlight insights and trends
  • Partner with internal teams to clarify metric definitions and ensure consistency across reporting
  • Document logic, definitions, and assumptions to support long term reuse
  • You Will Be a Great Addition to the Team If You Have


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 1 to 3 years of experience in data analytics, BI, or a related field
  • Moderate SQL experience with a willingness to learn and improve
  • Familiarity with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI
  • Strong analytical reasoning and the ability to connect data to business concepts
  • Clear written communication skills and the ability to summarize findings
  • Comfortable working independently and managing priorities in an async environment
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving


Extra skills that stand out:


  • A builder mentality with interest in creating small tools or solutions to improve workflows. Curiosity and experimentation with AI tools is a plus.
  • Experience working with SaaS metrics such as ARR, NRR, churn, pipeline, product usage, or LTV to CAC
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
  • Experience supporting finance, revenue, or business operations teams
  • Knowledge of Python or scripting for data automation is helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with data modeling or ELT concepts
  • Contract Structure



Red Oak Technologies is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. See what it’s like to be at the top; connect with one of our recruiters and apply today.

Learn what it’s like to be a Red Oak Consultant!

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Who are we?


Fulcrum Digital is an agile and next-generation digital accelerating company providing digital transformation and technology services right from ideation to implementation.

These services have applicability across a variety of industries including banking & financial services, insurance, retail, higher education, food, healthcare, and manufacturing. Headquartered in the bustling city of New Jersey, Fulcrum was rated among the fastest growing Software Companies in Inc 5000 Club and No. 7 Technology firm in New Jersey by NJ Biz.

Our team of business and technical consultants is spread across the US and other regions including the UK, Portugal, LATAM, Australia, and Finland where we have our operations.


The Role


We look for you to bring initiative and resourcefulness while you balance vital responsibilities. In this role, your primary mission will be to provide best-in-class executive support which involves a wide variety of duties that are critical to ensuring smooth and seamless business processes.


What you’ll do?


  • Heavy calendar management - owns and coordinates a heavy, complex meeting schedule that often includes international participants. Includes the management of calendars, related correspondence, meeting details, logistics coordination.
  • Events - Coordinates events and executive meetings, from recurring staff meetings to Town Hall meetings. Provides project management, budget management, space requirements, IT coordination, and all other support required for these various events and meetings.
  • Board Preparation - Prepares and manages communication, materials, and meeting preparation for the Board of Directors with perfect execution.
  • PowerPoint and Word Documents - Prepares electronic files with validated ability to proofread for spelling and grammar.
  • Office support activities.
  • Travel coordination- Leads and coordinates travel itineraries and related meetings, which are sometimes international. Includes the coordination of calendars, travel plans, expense reimbursements, filing, etc.
  • Other administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Requirements


  • Ability to handle highly sensitive business and human resources communications, data and other information with confidentiality and discretion.
  • Ability to establish relationships of strong communication and network within the administrative team. We will need to work cross-functionally regarding issues of travel, meeting schedules, and material completion.
  • Utilize knowledge of company operations, policies, and department functions to proactively perform assigned duties and with minimal direct supervision.
  • Resiliency; able to diplomatically and constructively, but firmly, ensure objectives are met.
  • Appropriate professional presentation. You should be able to communicate effectively with C-level executives, Board members, and other high-level clients and candidates, and line-level employees, with equal dexterity, respect, and composure. Also, be able to present oneself as a representative of the Manager's office, and, to a very large and diverse internal and external audience.
  • Ability to speak clearly and succinctly relative to needs, questions, goals, etc. Must be direct in asking for clarification, guidance, opinions, etc. of the executive to ensure accurate delivery on commitments, scheduling needs, meeting set-up, etc.
  • Able to act independently, operating on accurate details and excellent judgment.
  • Able to identify and leverage other resources within the business to clarify needs, delegate tasks, etc. in order to keep a very busy desk operating smoothly and efficiently.
  • A ‘can-do’ perspective is imperative, and the ability to simply ‘get-things-done’ under ambiguous, time-constrained, high-pressure circumstances routinely.
  • Able to quickly gain an understanding of the executive’s style and adapt own style and presentation to that of the executives. Effective interpersonal skills to be capable of working with all levels of office personnel.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office

title: Remote SAT English Tutor - 50997
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

Day-to-day responsibilities:

As an SAT Tutor, you will work remotely with high school students preparing for U.S. college admissions. Your sessions will focus on strengthening reading, writing, and mathematical reasoning skills using official materials and proven strategies. You’ll conduct timed practice tests, review performance, and create personalized study plans to help students maximize their scores. Clear communication, consistent feedback, and student motivation will be essential to building confidence and exam readiness.


Requirements:

We’re seeking experienced tutors with a strong record of preparing students for the SAT. Candidates should understand the digital SAT format, be familiar with College Board materials, and have excellent academic English skills. High SAT scores or standardized test prep certifications are preferred. Strong teaching abilities, virtual instruction skills, and a results-driven approach are essential. Communication in English: Ability to clearly convey feedback, nuances, and progress updates to the team.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: Availability of up to 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract: 1 month
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los-Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will go through an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Editor de vídeo
description:
A Artha Growth Studio está em expansão e buscamos um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeos para integrar nosso time.


Procuramos alguém com ritmo, visão estratégica de conteúdo e capacidade de transformar ideias em vídeos que geram retenção, autoridade e crescimento.


A Artha Growth Studio trabalha com diferentes formatos de conteúdo, de vídeos dinâmicos para redes sociais até criativos avançados, materiais corporativos e projetos para o mercado imobiliário.


Por isso, buscamos um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo que possa atuar no estilo de edição em que mais se identifica .


Você não precisa dominar tudo.


Queremos pessoas que sejam muito boas no que já fazem bem .


Sobre o trabalho

Você poderá atuar em diferentes tipos de projetos, como:

• Edição dinâmica de vídeos para YouTube, Reels, Shorts e TikTok.

• Criativos de marketing, VSL e materiais comerciais.

• Vídeos corporativos e institucionais.

• Projetos com motion, VFX ou 3D, especialmente em conteúdos imobiliários e empreendimentos.


Responsabilidades

• Edição de vídeos curtos e longos para redes sociais.

• Criação de cortes dinâmicos, legendas, transições e ritmo engajador.

• Adaptação de um vídeo-base para múltiplos formatos.

• Participação na construção da linha editorial e evolução do estilo visual da agência.

• Manter a qualidade e consistência do material da agência.

• Organização de arquivos, prazos e entregas.

• Comunicação clara com o time.

• Entrega consistente dentro dos prazos combinados.


Requisitos

• Experiência no estilo de edição que deseja atuar.

• Portfólio obrigatório.

• Domínio da ferramenta que você usa.

• Capacidade de criar vídeos com alta retenção (timing, cortes, velocidade).

• Vontade real de crescer junto com a agência.

Diferenciais

• Motion básico.

• Experiência com anúncios ou VSL.

• Experiência com 3D, CGI ou VFX.


Formato de trabalho

• PJ

• Remoto

• Remuneração por demanda ou mensal (dependendo da carga de projetos).

title: Pleno ServiceNow Developer with HAM/AM
description:
Esta é uma posição Full Time remota trabalhando no Brasil com clientes dos EUA.


Oferecemos :

  • R$ 5.000 a R$ 11.200 por mês dependendo da experiência
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação R$ 992,00
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco (Descontos Sujeitos a Alteração)
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche

Cargo: Desenvolvedor ServiceNow Pleno com HAM/AM

Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor de Gerenciamento de Ativos de Hardware (HAM) ServiceNow para implementar e manter processos de gerenciamento de ativos de hardware na plataforma ServiceNow. A função envolve garantir a integridade e precisão dos dados do CMDB, construir inventários, corrigir relacionamentos do CMDB e criar dashboards dedicados ao HAM. Você irá integrar ferramentas de inventário como SCCM, JAMF e Tanium com o ServiceNow, desenvolver e configurar workflows, regras de negócio e relatórios no módulo HAM, e apoiar auditorias internas e externas com informações confiáveis sobre ativos. A posição requer colaboração estreita com as equipes de Procurement, Finanças, Segurança e Infraestrutura para gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo dos ativos.


Qualificações Necessárias:

  • 2 anos de experiência em Desenvolvimento ServiceNow
  • Experiência prática em ServiceNow HAM ou AM
  • Experiência com SLO/SLI, DataDog, Azure e monitoramento de infraestrutura em nuvem
  • Proficiência em scripting (JavaScript, PowerShell), integrações de API e análise de plataforma
  • Familiaridade com processos ITIL e plataformas de gerenciamento de serviços corporativos (ex: BMC, OpenText)

title: Senior Gen AI Engineer (Copilot)
description:
Senior Generative AI Engineer – Copilot / Power AutomateSummary


We are seeking a Senior Generative AI Engineer with hands-on experience in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate to support and scale our organization’s use of AI-driven productivity tools. This role blends technical expertise in building and optimizing agents with the ability to support and guide non-technical users. The engineer will troubleshoot Copilot issues, review and refine agents, and ensure compliance with data loss prevention (DLP) and governance policies. Beyond day-to-day support, they’ll help strengthen our Power Platform Center of Excellence (COE) through documentation, lifecycle standards, and observability practices.


Key Responsibilities


  • Support & Troubleshooting: Own Copilot and Power Automate issue resolution, including connectors, permissions, and workflow errors.
  • Agent Review & Optimization: Refine agents for efficiency, scalability, and compliance with governance standards.
  • User Enablement: Guide employees in safely building and optimizing agents, explaining platform limits and data-handling best practices.
  • Architecture Awareness: Apply knowledge of agent architectures, prompt lifecycles, and RAG patterns to improve design quality.
  • Governance & COE: Partner with data, security, and compliance teams on DLP alignment and contribute to Power Platform COE monitoring and lifecycle initiatives.
  • Documentation & Improvement: Create user guides, document patterns, and propose enhancements based on recurring issues.


Required Skills


  • Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Automate (core ).
  • Ability to design, troubleshoot, and optimize agent workflows and connectors.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 ecosystem , DLP policies, and governance controls.
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures and prompt-response lifecycles.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to translate technical details for non-technical users.


Preferred Skills


  • Knowledge of RAG, multi-agent orchestration, or MCP server concepts.
  • Experience with observability, or cost monitoring.
  • Exposure to enterprise data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Dataverse, Azure Data Lake).
  • Contribution to a Power Platform COE or similar governance effort.


We Offer:


  • 100% remote job.
  • Long term job.
  • Carreer path.

title: Android Developer
description:
Open Video project is focused on OTT platform development for one of the largest North American TV providers. We are looking for Senior Software Developer who will be working on software development for the client hardware platform based on Android OS.


Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for development of embedded software engineering projects for Set-Top Box hardware using the latest software solutions and techniques. Work as an individual contributor while providing technical guidance to development and integration projects. Coordinate development process of Set-Top Box projects for various hardware platforms. Establish operational monitoring processes and dashboards using IT operations analytics and log analysis tools. Interact with systems analysts, software architects, developers and project management teams. Administer and prevent problems using issue tracking, team collaboration and planning tools. Prepare technical hand off and training documentation.
  • Experience required:
  • * Agile methodology
  • * Android development; Android TV is a plus. AOSP development is a plus
  • * Programming Languages: Java, Kotlin

  • * Agile methodology
  • * Android development
  • * Programming Languages: Java, Kotlin

  • * AOSP
  • * Android TV

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Electrical VDC Team Lead
description:
At Eracore, we’re committed to developing talented engineers and exposing them to some of the most exciting electrical projects in the country, while becoming the most trusted partners in the industry. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States, including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Under strong leadership, Eracore is quickly expanding their presence in Brazil. Our goal is to develop a team of the brightest minds to take on the biggest industry challenges on some of the coolest projects in the USA.


Visit our site to see some of our projects that we want you to be apart of --> eracore.com


Benefits of working with us:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual Bonus
  • Learning platforms that enable growth and development
  • Strong leadership and mentorship


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Oversee and lead the development, coordination, and delivery of Electrical BIM models across all project stages, ensuring compliance with project requirements, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and guide the Electrical BIM team by providing technical support, quality checks, and mentorship to ensure accurate and efficient model development.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Architectural, Structural, and other engineering teams) to ensure effective model coordination and clash-free deliverables.
  • Conduct regular model audits, data checks, and quality control reviews to ensure the integrity and reliability of electrical BIM deliverables.
  • Prepare and deliver BIM-related documentation, including model execution plans, progress reports, schedules, and technical presentations.
  • Support the integration of BIM with other digital tools such as Navisworks, Revit and clash detection software for enhanced project delivery.
  • Identify process gaps and propose improvements to enhance BIM efficiency, model accuracy, and team productivity.
  • Train and upskill team members on BIM technologies, electrical modeling techniques, and emerging industry trends.
  • Coordinate with client BIM teams to understand project expectations, provide updates, and ensure smooth communication throughout the project lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Electrical BIM modeling, coordination, and project delivery.
  • Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Electrical discipline) with strong understanding of electrical systems
  • Strong experience using Navisworks for clash detection, coordination, and model review.
  • Familiarity with BIM 360, ACC, Bluebeam, and other industry tools.
  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide juniors while maintaining high-quality output.
  • Ability to manage project timelines and client expectations.


Preferrable

  • Solid understanding of U.S. construction practices, NEC codes, and electrical engineering principle.
  • Experience in developing BIM standards, workflows, and templates for electrical systems.
  • Prior experience working on Data Centers.

title: Business Development Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated student to join our international Sales Team and support business development activities in the public sector across various countries. Are you currently studying, would you like to gain professional experience alongside your studies and get to know an innovative employer? Then apply - we look forward to hearing from you! You will be part of a diverse and collaborative team spread across multiple locations, working closely with experienced professionals to identify, evaluate, and pursue opportunities in different areas.


Job Definition

> Scout and assess opportunities in the public sector via procurement portals in different countries

> Support the preparation of proposals by gathering relevant data and documentation

> Create and tailor project references and CVs to meet tender requirements

> Collaborate with team members to maintain an internal knowledge base of public tenders and best practices


Job Qualifications

> Fluent in Portuguese, with business-level proficiency in German and English (B2-C1)

> Very good knowledge in MS-Office, mainly MS-Excel, and MS-Teams

> Strong planning, organizational, and communication skills

> Reliable, detail-oriented, and proactive, able to take ownership and motivated to learn quickly

> Interest in public sector processes, international collaboration, and technology-driven projects

> Previous experience with procurement in the public sector will be seen as a plus


Benefits

> A highly innovative, agile and unique team with a great working culture and an employer that appreciates new initiatives and ideas

> We support, offer and cover the cost of language courses from level A1 to C1

> Enjoy daily supportive lunch provisions and benefits

> We support you to help you grow individually by a variety of training programmes

title: Account Manager
description:
Role: Account Manager - B2B iGaming

Location: Brazil


A leading international provider of digital entertainment solutions is looking for an Account Manager to oversee and grow client relationships within the Brazilian market.


In this role, you will be part of a dynamic Account Management team focused on revenue growth, client success, and the effective delivery of gaming solutions across Latin America.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring consistent communication and satisfaction
  • Take full commercial ownership of accounts, driving revenue growth and achieving performance objectives
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans aligned with client needs and business goals
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights and guidance to optimize client operations and promotional strategies
  • Ensure timely delivery of gaming products and solutions according to client requirements
  • Monitor and report on monthly revenue performance, identifying opportunities for growth
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships at all organizational levels
  • Represent the company at industry exhibitions, conferences, and networking events
  • Promote and uphold the organization’s values and brand reputation


Requirements:


  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in B2B account management within the iGaming industry, ideally for a slot or game provider
  • Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese and English; Spanish fluency is an advantage
  • Native or resident of a LATAM market (for example Brazil, Colombia, or Peru)
  • Proven ability to manage high-value accounts and build long-term client partnerships
  • Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills with experience engaging stakeholders at all levels
  • Demonstrated success in delivering client-focused solutions that meet strategic business goals
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and promotion management tools preferred
  • Highly proactive, results-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, data-driven approach
  • Willingness to travel and represent the company at industry events


What’s Offered:


  • Competitive salary with annual performance reviews
  • Transparent quarterly bonus structure based on results
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage for you and a partner
  • Financial assistance for significant life events
  • Reimbursement for professional development, training, and educational courses

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.


Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.

title: Líder Técnico III (Web/Mobile/Servidores)
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar na liderança técnica de projetos de software, no ICC PDI SW.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de desenvolvimento de software; propondo soluções que atendam ao negócio e sejam performáticas e flexíveis, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções integradas;
  • Realizar a especificação funcional de projetos, definindo e documentando arquitetura lógica e executável de sistemas;
  • Projetar software para integração e entrega contínua;
  • Prover solução e suporte para o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicações móveis, web e servidora;
  • Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível;
  • Realizar o planejamento e o monitoramento das atividades técnicas dos projetos.
  • Prover capacitação, orientação e suporte técnico aos desenvolvedores;
  • Revisar código desenvolvido conforme boas práticas da tecnologia;
  • Prover suporte ao time de QA;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica do projeto, operacionais e de apoio à gerência;
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos artefatos técnicos desenvolvidos;
  • Desenvolver e manter padrões de codificação e documentação técnica, promovendo a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias;
  • Resolver problemas técnicos complexos e fornecer suporte técnico à equipe, removendo impedimentos e facilitando o progresso do trabalho.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;
  • Vivência na gestão de projetos ligados a tecnologias Mobile
  • Experiência em práticas de DevOps, incluindo Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD e monitoramento;
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento de soluções Web, aplicações móveis e soluções em nuvem;
  • Domínio em banco de dados não relacional/relacional, Webservices, Design patterns, Modelagem de projetos, Ferramentas de análise de código e de controle de versionamento de código;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis, especialmente Scrum, e ferramentas de gestão de projetos como JIRA;
  • Conhecimentos em testes automatizados e unitários e ferramentas de design UX/UI.



Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta, das 8h as 12h e das 13h30 as 17h30.


Local de trabalho : As atividades poderão ser realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho "Home Office".

title: Site Reliability Engineer Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE Sr)

Contratação CLT


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.
  • Atuar em incidentes e ajudar a reduzir MTTR.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia usando melhores práticas em SRE;
  • Experiência em ambientes Multi-cloud (OCI ou AWS) ou híbridos;
  • Atuação com CI/CD (GitLab, ArgoCD e similares);
  • Experiência solida com Infrastructure as Code (Terraform e similares)
  • Automação e scripting (Python, Go ou Bash/Shell);
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana LGTM, OTel).
  • Domínio de containers e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Chaos Engineering;
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Certificações em Cloud.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
About us


We are a leading global player in the digital assets industry, operating one of the most advanced and trusted ecosystems in the blockchain space. With a user base exceeding 120 million worldwide, our platform offers a comprehensive suite of digital asset products and services designed to meet the needs of both retail and institutional clients.


Our mission is to accelerate the evolution of the digital economy by enabling secure, intelligent, and efficient transactions. We believe digital assets are redefining the foundations of global finance — and we are committed to empowering that transformation responsibly.


As one of the fastest-growing organizations in the sector, we foster a culture of innovation, integrity, and excellence. For professionals seeking meaningful challenges, cutting-edge projects, and the opportunity to shape the future of finance, we provide an environment that values both expertise and vision.


What you'll do


  • Drive overall business expansion across the Brazil region, setting strategies and delivering measurable growth.
  • Oversee business development, marketing, and operations with a deep understanding of growth levers to boost user acquisition and trading activity.
  • Operate as a true business owner—design new initiatives to elevate operational excellence, refine the local business model, and execute plans end-to-end.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing local team, determining hiring needs and shaping the long-term market strategy.
  • Manage budgeting, P&L performance, and financial goals to meet user and trading volume targets.
  • Lead major local marketing efforts, including partnership development and the execution of key events.
  • Serve as the company’s representative at local events, in media engagements, and in communications with external stakeholders.


What You’ll Need

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience with demonstrated success in a comparable leadership role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal abilities and proven leadership skills with an entrepreneurial mindset.
  • A strong passion for the cryptocurrency space.
  • Native-level proficiency in Spanish and English.

title: Software Engineer (Murex)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Murex Developer to join our team, supporting strategic initiatives within the financial sector. The role begins as fully remote , with the expectation of relocation to Portugal after an agreed transition period. You will work closely with multicultural teams, contributing to the enhancement and stability of the Murex MX.3 platform.


Responsibilities

  • Develop, customize, and maintain components and configurations within Murex MX.3 , across modules such as Trading, Risk, Collateral, and Back Office.
  • Build and enhance workflows, simulation views, formulas, and MxML Exchange interfaces.
  • Design and maintain integrations with internal and external systems (REST, SOAP, MQ, APIs, ETL, etc.).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production incidents, ensuring system stability and performance.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, QA, and project teams to gather requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Support release cycles, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT phases.
  • Maintain compliance with technical standards, documentation, and governance processes.


Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Murex MX.3 (configuration, development, or integration).
  • Solid knowledge of Datamart, MxML Exchange, Workflows, Simulation Views , and other core Murex components.
  • Strong programming skills: Java, SQL, Shell Script , and ideally Python.
  • Experience with system integrations, middleware, or messaging platforms.
  • Good understanding of financial instruments, especially derivatives (FX, IRD, Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities).
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Willingness and eligibility to relocate to Portugal after the initial remote period.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience working with major banks or large international financial institutions.
  • Knowledge of DevOps methodologies and tools (CI/CD, Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum .
  • Murex certifications or experience with MX.2 → MX.3 migrations.

Desired Profile

  • Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving ability.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in remote and multicultural environments.
  • Proactive, organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure.
  • Motivated to engage in a long-term role involving relocation.

What We Offer

  • Remote work during the initial phase.
  • Support and guidance for future relocation to Portugal .
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Opportunity to work on complex, high-impact financial systems.
  • Multicultural work environment and professional growth opportunities.

title: Analista de recrutamento & seleção PL
description:
A Chilli Beans é uma empresa jovem que investe em pessoas de mente aberta e interessadas em abraçar novos conceitos. Esta é uma de nossas maiores riquezas, é uma espécie de vírus que contagia levando o DNA da pimenta desde os funcionários do escritório central, franqueados, até o consumidor final.

Nosso ambiente é descolado, informal e com muita espontaneidade, a marca foi inspirada em música, moda e arte e os nossos valores são totalmente voltados à inovação, ousadia, diversidade e alegria.

E aí, está a fim de fazer parte do time mais apimentado da América Latina?


Então dê uma olhada na vaga abaixo. \o/


Quais os requisitos para essa posição:


  • Ensino superior completo em RH ou Psicologia;
  • Experiência há mais de 5 anos com Recrutamento & seleção;
  • Fácil acesso a Alphaville e disponibilidade para atuar 100% presencial;
  • Experiência com empresas de varejo;
  • Perfil hands'on para atuar com alto volume de contratações;


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?


  • Recrutamento & seleção and to and para vagas administrativas do showroom Chilli Beans;
  • Elaboração de relatórios e pareceres de perfis;
  • Alimentação de planilhas e dashboards;
  • Treinamentos & integrações;
  • Entrevista de desligamento;


Nossos benefícios:


  • Plano de saúde.
  • Plano odontológico.
  • Vale refeição (inclusive nas férias).
  • Vale transporte ou vale combustível.
  • Estacionamento gratuito.
  • Gympass.


Nossos diferenciais:


  • Day off de aniversário.
  • Somos pet friendly, aqui seu pet é super bem vindo.
  • Massagem semanal.

title: SR Desenvolvimento Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Apoiar o time tecnicamente com os projetos, garantindo a qualidade técnica e a eficácia do desenvolvimento;
  • Manutenção nas funcionalidades existentes;
  • Documentação técnica dentro do escopo do time;
  • Análise e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo;
  • Colaboração com o time na definição de novas abordagens ou tecnologias.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java (11+);
  • Conhecimento em Spring e Spring Boot;
  • Conhecimento em Ruby;
  • APIs e integrações;
  • Experiência em RESTful APIs;
  • Conhecimento em cloud computing;
  • Conhecimento em AWS;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança da informação;
  • Autenticação, Autorização e Criptografia;
  • Prevenção de ataques.


Diferenciais:

  • Familiaridade com frameworks ágeis (Scrum e Kanban);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas Atlassian: JIRA e Confluence;
  • Experiência React e React Native;
  • Experiência JavaScript (Node.js);
  • Axway - API Gateway;
  • Conhecimento em Continuous Integration: Git, Jenkins e Docker;
  • Mensageria;
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.



Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília


Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.


Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;


Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 118 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.
  • Strong ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Skilled in relationship building across organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with scientific information tools and intellectual property solutions (preferred).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: Vendedor Credito Imobiliário e Automotivo
description:
Vaga: Consultor de Crédito – Home Equity e Auto Equity | Strategy Analytics


A Strategy Analytics está expandindo sua operação e selecionando Consultores Associados (PJ) para originação de crédito com foco em Home Equity e Auto Equity.

Buscamos profissionais com carteira ativa, disciplina comercial e forte capacidade de relacionamento.


Responsabilidades

• Atuação com carteira própria de clientes.

• Prospecção ativa e constância comercial semanal.

• Atendimento consultivo do início ao fim da operação.

• Subida e organização de documentos no OneDrive no padrão institucional.

• Condução completa da operação: pré-análise, coleta, vistoria, proposta final e assinatura.

• Acompanhamento de cada cliente até o repasse final.


Modelo de Trabalho

• Regime PJ

• Formato remoto

• Horários flexíveis

• Remuneração totalmente variável via comissionamento


Comissionamento


Home Equity

• Até R$ 2 milhões: 3%

• Acima de R$ 2 milhões: 2,25%

Repasse após assinatura, protocolo e envio da NF-e, em até 10 dias úteis.


Auto Equity – Conversão E2E

• Abaixo de 1,50%: 1,5%

• 1,50% a 2,50%: 2%

• 2,50% a 3,50%: 2,5%

• Acima de 3,50%: 3%

Comissão liberada somente para contratos pagos; repasse quinzenal.


Período de Efetivação – 90 dias

Primeiros 90 dias são período de avaliação, onde o consultor já recebe comissão normalmente.

Avaliação baseada em: volume de propostas, organização no OneDrive, constância comercial e aderência ao padrão Strategy.

Após esse período, havendo desempenho satisfatório, o consultor pode ser efetivado na estrutura oficial.


Requisitos

• Carteira ativa de clientes

• CNPJ ativo (ou abertura imediata)

• Experiência em crédito ou vendas financeiras

• Notebook, celular e internet estável

• Organização, clareza de comunicação e disciplina

title: SAP EPPM C4P
description:
SAP EPPM & Resource Management Consultant (Public Cloud)


Location: Lisbon (Hybrid)

Contract Type: 1-year B2B, with strong possibility of permanent placement

Language: English (mandatory) — French is an added value


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced SAP EPPM & Resource Management Consultant with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud , particularly in processes related to C4P (Customer for Projects) . You will play a key role in supporting and optimizing project management, resource planning, and project-related operational processes in a dynamic, international environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support implementations and enhancements in SAP EPPM on S/4HANA Public Cloud
  • Configure and optimize Resource Management , workforce planning, and project staffing flows
  • Integrate project operations with C4P and related Public Cloud modules
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into efficient SAP Public Cloud solutions
  • Provide functional expertise, best practices, documentation, and user training
  • Ensure alignment between business stakeholders and technical teams
  • Support testing cycles, UAT sessions, and go-live/hypercare phases
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of project portfolio management processes

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as SAP consultant in EPPM , Resource Management , or Project Systems (PS)
  • Solid knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud configuration
  • Experience with C4P / Project Collaboration / SAP Public Cloud for Projects is a strong plus
  • Understanding of project financials, resource scheduling, and project lifecycle processes
  • Ability to work in international teams; excellent communication skills in English
  • French language skills are an added advantage

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on leading-edge SAP Public Cloud solutions
  • Hybrid working model in Lisbon
  • 1-year B2B contract with the advantage of progressing to a stable permanent position
  • Collaborative, international work environment

title: Prestador(a) de Serviços em Desenvolvimento de Software (PJ – Nível Inicial)
description:
Identificação da Prestação de Serviços

Título: Prestador(a) de Serviços em Desenvolvimento de Software (PJ – Nível Inicial)

Atuação: Desenvolvimento de software para o AdvSpace

Ponto de contato técnico: Breno Andrade

Local de prestação: Remoto

Modalidade de contratação: Prestação de serviços como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)

Valor: R$ 2.500,00 mensais, mediante emissão de nota fiscal, podendo ser ajustado de acordo com o escopo de serviços e a dedicação estimada, a ser definida em comum acordo.


Descrição da Empresa


AdvSpace é o último software jurídico que um escritório jurídico brasileiro utilizará em sua existência.


Com o uso por dezenas de escritórios ao redor do Brasil, o AdvSpace integra gestão, atendimento e automação com Inteligência Artificial, aumentando a produtividade em escala.

Esta é uma oportunidade para participar da história de um produto digital em crescimento.


Missão da Prestação de Serviços


Produzir soluções em forma de software para o AdvSpace, atuando na evolução contínua do produto, seja na melhoria de funcionalidades existentes, seja na construção de novas soluções, com foco em qualidade técnica, prazos e alinhamento com os objetivos do sistema.


Principais Atividades / Entregas


  • Desenvolver código para o AdvSpace conforme processos e padrões de qualidade acordados.
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento técnico e de planejamento, quando previamente agendadas.
  • Participar de encontros de atualização técnica e de produto que sejam relevantes para a boa execução dos serviços.
  • Sugerir melhorias em produtos e/ou processos existentes relacionados ao AdvSpace.
  • Reportar as entregas realizadas e em andamento, conforme rotinas de acompanhamento combinadas.
  • Documentar tecnicamente as implementações realizadas, quando necessário para manutenção futura.



Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)


  • Algoritmo e Programação.
  • Lógica-Matemática.
  • Inteligência Artificial.
  • HTML 5.
  • React.
  • Python.
  • Typescript.
  • Serverless.
  • PostgreSQL.
  • Git.
  • RESTful API.
  • CI/CD.
  • Clean Code.
  • Interpretação de texto.
  • Inglês avançado (boa leitura e escrita).


Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


  • Transparência.
  • Comprometimento.
  • Comunicação.
  • Pensamento crítico.
  • Idoneidade.
  • Autocontrole.



Formação e Experiência


Formação mínima: Estudante de Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência desejável: Não é necessária experiência profissional prévia; experiência em projetos acadêmicos ou pessoais será considerada.

Certificações / cursos complementares: Certificações e cursos relacionados às tecnologias e competências indicadas na vaga serão considerados diferenciais.


Indicadores de Resultado

  • Cumprimento de prazos de entrega.
  • Qualidade técnica das entregas (baixa taxa de retrabalho).
  • Aderência aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos definidos.
  • Evolução contínua na capacidade de contribuição para o produto.



Relacionamentos Internos e Externos


Relacionamentos internos: Ponto de contato técnico, integrantes da equipe de tecnologia, áreas operacional, marketing e vendas, quando necessário para execução das entregas.

Relacionamentos externos: Parceiros de integração do AdvSpace, quando houver necessidade técnica de alinhamento.



Ferramentas e Tecnologias Utilizadas


  • Supabase.
  • Vercel.
  • Windsurf.
  • Lovable.
  • GitHub.
  • Sistema da empresa.
  • Linear.
  • Google Workspace.



Perfil Ideal do Profissional


Profissional planejador e/ou analítico, com interesse genuíno em atuar em produto digital, capacidade de resolver problemas de forma estruturada, abertura a feedbacks e disposição para aprender continuamente.



Organização do trabalho:

  • Não há controle formal de jornada. O(a) profissional organiza seus próprios horários, desde que cumpra as entregas e prazos combinados.
  • A dedicação semanal será alinhada previamente, de acordo com o volume de demandas.
  • Reuniões de alinhamento e planejamento ocorrerão, em regra, em horário comercial (entre 9h e 18h, de segunda a sexta-feira).


Exclusividade:

  • Não há exigência de exclusividade, sendo facultado ao(à) profissional prestar serviços a outros contratantes, desde que não haja conflito direto com empresas que ofereçam soluções concorrentes ao AdvSpace.


Para participar do processo seletivo, favor acesse o seguinte link:


A vaga está aberta enquanto o formulário desse link estiver ativo.


Caso você seja selecionado, receberá um e-mail de Favor atente-se à sua caixa de SPAM até o dia 31/12/2025, que é quando iremos encerrar o processo seletivo.


Observações:

Em caso de dúvidas, mande e-mail para Por gentileza não mande WhatsApp ou ligue. O candidato que não seguir essa regra será desclassificado.

Missão da Prestação de Serviços


Produzir soluções em forma de software para o AdvSpace, atuando na evolução contínua do produto, seja na melhoria de funcionalidades existentes, seja na construção de novas soluções, com foco em qualidade técnica, prazos e alinhamento com os objetivos do sistema.


Principais Atividades / Entregas

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.
company: 绿新(福建)食品有限公司

title: Product Owner Sr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Product Owner Sr

contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de um Product Owner (PO), responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento de soluções que otimizem as jornadas de compras no ecossistema B2B, alinhando objetivos de negócio às necessidades dos clientes.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Gerenciar o backlog de produto, priorizando demandas com base no impacto para o negócio e nos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (design, engenharia, negócios) para garantir a entrega de soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade.
  • Definir histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação com base nas necessidades dos stakeholders.
  • Analisar e mapear processos de compras para propor melhorias que agreguem valor aos nossos clientes.
  • Atuar como referência interna em processos de compras, com conhecimentos complementares em tributação e finanças, garantindo que as soluções atendam às normas e regulamentações aplicáveis.
  • Monitorar KPIs e avaliar a performance das soluções implementadas.


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em posições semelhantes.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em processos de compras corporativas será considerado um diferencial;
  • Bons conhecimentos em Inteligência Artificial (IA) , com experiência em diversas LLMs e engenharia de prompt.
  • Habilidade em criar e gerenciar roadmaps de produto.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência com plataformas de e-procurement ou marketplace B2B é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados.


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações em Agile (CSPO, SAFe) ou Product Management.
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de tecnologia ou consultoria em processos de compras e/ou finanças.

VR/VA em cartão flexível
