title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Apricot Jam


Apricot Jam is a US based consulting and technology company working with Fortune 500 and large enterprise clients worldwide. We design and deliver next generation enterprise solutions combining ServiceNow, AI driven automation, and strong engineering practices.


Our teams operate across Europe the US and Asia, working in a culture that values ownership, curiosity, and continuous growth. We believe great software is built by people who care deeply about quality, collaboration, and impact.


Role Overview


We are looking for skilled ServiceNow Developers to join our growing delivery team. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building modern enterprise applications and want to work across advanced ServiceNow capabilities including UI Builder, AI Agent Studio, App Engine, and ERP focused integrations.


You will work closely with solution architects, functional consultants, and client stakeholders to design and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. The more of the skills below you bring, the more impact you can have.


What You Will Do


• Design configure and develop custom solutions on the ServiceNow platform

• Build modern user experiences using UI Builder and Next Experience

• Develop applications using App Engine including ERP related use cases

• Configure and extend workflows using Flow Designer and platform automation

• Implement integrations using IntegrationHub REST and Zero Copy Connector patterns

• Work with AI Agent Studio and Now Assist related capabilities where applicable

• Translate business requirements into clean scalable technical solutions

• Participate in technical workshops solution reviews and demos

• Collaborate with global teams across Europe and the US

• Contribute to best practices performance optimization and platform governance


Required and Desired Skills


• 3 plus years of hands on ServiceNow development experience

• Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

• Strong JavaScript skills including client and server side scripting

• Experience with one or more of the following is highly valued

• UI Builder and custom workspace development

• AI Agent Studio or Now Assist related configurations

• App Engine Studio and custom application development

• ERP related ServiceNow use cases

• ERP Canvas and Zero Copy Connector experience

• Solid understanding of ServiceNow data models security and performance

• Experience with Flow Designer IntegrationHub and APIs

• Ability to work in a client facing environment


Certifications are a strong plus

• CSA CAD

• CIS certifications ITSM CSM HRSD ITAM or App Engine


Why Join Apricot Jam


• Work on complex high impact ServiceNow implementations for US enterprise clients

• Be part of a senior globally distributed ServiceNow team

• Exposure to cutting edge ServiceNow capabilities including AI and ERP integrations

• Support for certifications learning and career growth

• Competitive compensation based on experience and contribution

• A people first culture built on trust autonomy and collaboration

title: Clinical Trainer LATAM
description:
About Lumenis

Lumenis is a world leader in laser- and light-based technologies for medical and aesthetic applications. Ever since introducing the first medical laser system in the world nearly 45 years ago, Lumenis has been at the forefront of technological innovation and market leadership in its segment. Today, Lumenis offers a wide range of products, an unparalleled technical support system, the largest global installed-base of medical laser products and one of the largest investments in research and development in the industry. Lumenis has installed more than 60,000 medical systems in doctors’ offices, clinics and operating rooms in more than 75 countries around the world. The company has over 100 FDA clearances; more than 250 registered patents & patent applications; and a team of 900 employees that work in synergy worldwide. Further, Lumenis is a truly an international organization, with direct business offices in strategic locations around the world, including the United States, UK, Germany, Israel, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan and Australia.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


We’re looking for a Mobile Engineer with a strong experience implementing apps with the languages and frameworks created by Apple for iOS and Google for Android.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • 5+ years experience on native mobile development across both platforms: iOS and Android
  • iOS development with SwiftUI
  • Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: Analista IBM Planning Analytics (TM1)
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como referência técnica em IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) em ambiente corporativo ou AMS, sendo responsável pela modelagem avançada , automação de processos , desenvolvimento de relatórios e dashboards , além da otimização de performance da plataforma, garantindo qualidade, governança e aderência às necessidades do negócio .


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar cubes, dimensions, hierarquias, rules e feeders no IBM Planning Analytics (TM1).
  • Criar, gerenciar e otimizar processos TurboIntegrator (TI) para carga, integração e automação de dados.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar relatórios e dashboards utilizando PAW (Planning Analytics Workspace), Perspectives, WebSheets e Excel .
  • Garantir governança, versionamento, documentação e aplicação de melhores práticas de modelagem multidimensional.
  • Realizar integrações com ERPs corporativos (ex.: SAP, Oracle) e bancos de dados SQL/NoSQL .
  • Executar tuning de performance , análise e resolução de incidentes complexos relacionados à plataforma.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, apoiando definições técnicas e funcionais.
  • Mentorar analistas Pleno e Júnior , promovendo boas práticas, padronização e evolução técnica da equipe.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência avançada em IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 .
  • Domínio de TurboIntegrator (TI) , rules , feeders e modelagem multidimensional .
  • Experiência sólida em relatórios, dashboards e automação (PAW, Perspectives, WebSheets, Excel).
  • Experiência em integrações com ERPs corporativos e bancos de dados SQL .
  • Conhecimento comprovado em tuning de performance e otimização de cubes .

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Senior Solution Architect (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.

Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .

Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ Descrição:

Você liderará decisões arquiteturais de produtos e plataformas críticas, definindo conceitos fundamentais, elementos e relações do sistema conforme boas práticas de arquitetura. Você conectará estratégia de produto a soluções cloud‑native escaláveis, seguras e observáveis, promovendo governança técnica, redução de dívida e eficiência de custos (FinOps).


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Definir e evoluir arquitetura (microserviços/event‑driven, APIs) com ADRs (Architecture Decision Records), padrões e guias — reduzindo retrabalho e melhorando coerência entre equipes.
  • Estabelecer SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators / Service Level Objectives) e observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces com OpenTelemetry) para diagnóstico ágil e MTTR menor.
  • Planejar capacidade, desempenho e resiliência (caching, tolerância a falhas, back‑pressure) — melhorando disponibilidade.
  • Eleger tecnologias (Azure/AWS/GCP, bancos relacionais/noSQL, mensageria) com análise de trade‑offs e custo total de propriedade.
  • Governança técnica: promover boas práticas (DDD, testes, segurança por design), revisões arquiteturais e quality gates em CI/CD.
  • Segurança/Privacidade: aplicar OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, gestão de segredos e princípios LGPD.
  • FinOps: co‑liderar otimização de uso e rates (tagueamento, unit economics), equilibrando custo vs. performance.
  • Mentoria e influência: apoiar tech leads, alinhar com PO/PM, SRE/Operações e Segurança; comunicar riscos, dependências e impactos.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Arquiteturas distribuídas (microserviços, event‑driven) e APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Event‑driven architecture: modelar domínios e eventos, Kafka (tópicos/partições, schema registry, DLQ), RabbitMQ — aumentando resiliência e throughput.
  • Plataformas de integração: Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) e/ou OSB/ODI/CDC (OGG).
  • Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP), Containers & Orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes) e IaC (Terraform/Helm).
  • Observabilidade e SLIs/SLOs; instrumentação e dashboards (ex.: Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry).
  • CI/CD (GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/GitLab), qualidade (SonarQube) e segurança (SAST/DAST).
  • Bancos de dados (PostgreSQL/MongoDB/Redis), modelagem e performance.
  • Segurança por design e LGPD.


❇️ Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Computação/Engenharia de Software/SI (ou experiência equivalente).


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaboração e influência sem autoridade; facilitação de decisões
  • Pensamento sistêmico e análise de trade‑offs; mentoria
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Colaboração
  • Foco no cliente
  • Visão de dono


❇️ Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Event sourcing, sagas, gRPC, estratégias blue/green/canary.
  • Práticas SRE (erro budget, post‑mortem) e FinOps avançado.
  • Certificações: Cloud Architect (AWS/Azure/GCP), CKA/CKAD, TOGAF (contexto EA), DASA/DevOps, SRE.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada;
  • Trilha de carreira.

title: Data Management Analyst
description:
About InComm

InComm is a global leader in the payments industry with over 30 years of experience and a presence in 30+ countries. As pioneers in gift cards, we hold two-thirds of the global market share.

Our mission is to revolutionize global commerce through innovative payment technologies for retailers, brands, and consumers.


Job Summary

We are looking for Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team. This role is fully remote in Brazil (CLT) and offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic environment supporting critical data processes.


We are seeking Data Management Coordinator professionals to join our team in fully remote positions based in Brazil (CLT). This role supports critical data processes and requires strong attention to detail, accuracy, and collaboration across multiple teams.


While all coordinators will work within MDM processes, there are two distinct specializations :

  • Credit & Contract Administration – Responsible for managing the contract lifecycle, reviewing documentation for accuracy, performing credit checks, and ensuring proper data entry across multiple platforms.
  • Location & Administrative Maintenance – Focused on maintaining location data integrity, including new setups, updates, closures, and supporting special projects related to merchant and location administration.


Both specializations play a key role in supporting operational excellence and require the ability to meet deadlines while delivering high-quality results.


Responsibilities

  • Process assignments within standard timelines (2 business days)
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of data in MDM systems
  • Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Finance teams
  • Track and report data metrics for compliance and performance


Credit & Contract Administration:

  • Review incoming contract documentation for discrepancies
  • Perform credit checks in accordance with company policy
  • Enter approved contracts into multiple systems
  • Maintain merchant documentation and follow up on pending agreements


Location & Administrative Maintenance:

  • Set up new locations and update existing records in MDM
  • Manage location name changes, moves, closures, and inactivations
  • Support special projects assigned by the Data Administration Team


Requirements

  • College degree preferred (not required)
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP and report comparison functions) for MDM profile
  • Administrative experience and ORACLE knowledge for contract profile
  • Ability to learn quickly and work well in a team
  • Credit review experience is a plus


Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills
  • Ability to manage repetitive tasks efficiently
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills


Benefits

Monthly internet/mobile allowance

️ Meal and food vouchers

Annual bonus

Health and dental plan

title: Analista GIS Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga


  • Analisar, planejar e executar as atividades da área de Customer Success da Diretoria de Experiência do Cliente, com foco na satisfação e sucesso dos clientes.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Ajudar o cliente a alcançar os objetivos idealizados com a compra de nossa plataforma;
  • Gerir o Onboarding;
  • Upsell & Cross Sell;
  • Reuniões de tomada de decisão e projetos;
  • Propor as melhores soluções aos clientes, sejam mudanças ou manutenções;
  • Follow ups frequentes sobre o andamento do projeto dos clientes;
  • Avaliar indicadores de performance e resultados dos clientes;
  • Colher feedbacks sobre o produto ou serviço;
  • Elaborar e apresentar reports para que o cliente fique ciente de onde está e para onde vai;
  • Nutrir o cliente com informações sobre a plataforma de forma estratégica;
  • Gerenciar conflitos de expectativa, solucionando eventuais problemas e acionando as áreas envolvidas, incluindo à Qualidade Imagem para melhorias contínuas de nossos processos;
  • Garantir a utilização completa da plataforma de acordo com os objetivos do cliente;
  • Fazer a ponte entre os feedbacks dos clientes e operação/comercial/marketing/fornecedores.


Requisitos e qualificações

Formação:

  • Graduado em Ciências da Terra.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Atendimento a clientes internos e externos;
  • Conceitos básicos das metodológicas de Customer Experience e Customer Success;
  • Conhecimentos em GIS;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados;
  • Vivência em projetos;
  • Conhecimento em TI (Banco de Dados e automações com Python);
  • Conhecimento sólido em ArcGIS (ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Enterprise e aplicativos como Survey, Dashboards etc.);
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de recursos naturais ou geomarketing (ambiental, mineração, óleo e gás).


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado;
  • Power BI;
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos produtos e serviços oferecidos pela Imagem.

title: Analista N2 de Teams Ideas Sênior
description:
Objetivo da Posição


Atuar como ponto central na facilitação e gestão de ideias e demandas por meio do Teams Ideas , garantindo organização, priorização estratégica, alinhamento entre áreas e comunicação clara. O profissional será responsável por estruturar iniciativas, apoiar a tomada de decisão e transformar insumos de múltiplas fontes em planos de ação executáveis , gerando valor para o negócio.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar como referência N2 na plataforma Teams Ideas , apoiando usuários e áreas de negócio na estruturação e acompanhamento de ideias e demandas.
  • Facilitar a coleta, análise, organização e priorização de ideias, garantindo clareza de escopo e alinhamento estratégico.
  • Conduzir e facilitar reuniões, workshops e rituais colaborativos , promovendo engajamento e alinhamento entre stakeholders.
  • Estruturar e manter backlogs, roadmaps e planos de ação , assegurando visibilidade e acompanhamento das iniciativas.
  • Aplicar frameworks de priorização (RICE, MoSCoW, Matriz de Valor, 5W2H, entre outros) para apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Produzir e manter documentação clara e objetiva , como briefings, atas, relatórios executivos e registros de decisões.
  • Atuar na interface entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e governança, garantindo fluidez na comunicação e execução das demandas.
  • Apoiar a melhoria contínua dos processos de gestão de ideias e demandas.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com Teams Ideas ou plataformas similares de gestão de ideias, demandas ou inovação.
  • Forte habilidade em análise de negócios , interpretação de necessidades e estruturação de requisitos.
  • Experiência comprovada em facilitação de reuniões, workshops e cerimônias organizacionais .
  • Conhecimento prático em frameworks de priorização (RICE, MoSCoW, Matriz de Valor, 5W2H).
  • Conhecimentos intermediários ou avançados em Microsoft 365 (Teams, Planner, SharePoint, OneNote, Excel, entre outros).
  • Capacidade de criar e manter documentação estruturada e objetiva .


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento ou vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos com múltiplos stakeholders.
  • Atuação prévia como PMO, Analista de Negócios, Product Ops ou funções similares.

title: Appointment Setter / Outbound Lead Generator (Remote & Commission Only)
description:
About Us


We run two online businesses in the airbnb & short term rental space:

  • GrowYourBnb – an established airbnb growth partner agency
  • AutomateYourBnb – an online software platform ( on process to be set)


We are looking for a motivated individual to help with lead generation, DM conversations, and appointment setting. Full training will be provided.


Role Responsibilities

  • Aiming to send atleast 200 qualified outbound messages per day
  • Respond to inbound Instagram enquiries and pass it to senior appointment setter to close
  • Send daily outbound messages on Instagram & LinkedIn
  • Adding new strategy with new ways to find leads ( using Google or AI)
  • Qualify leads through 1-to-1 DM conversations (training provided)
  • Manage and track leads via CRM.
  • Post Instagram Stories with Call-to-Actions
  • Daily reporting via Slack
  • Work directly with the business owner.


Working Hours

  • 5 days per week
  • 8 hours per day
  • UK time focused


Experience

  • Open to all experience levels
  • Previous outbound lead generation or appointment setting experience is a bonus
  • Have worked on sales before or enjoy doing sales.
  • Have atleast worked on a DM offer previously.


Ideal Candidate

  • Strong written English
  • Confident communicator
  • Organised and consistent
  • Comfortable using Instagram & LinkedIn
  • Willing to learn and follow systems
  • Sales


Rewards: Commission Only & No Base.


To Apply:


Send a short introduction about yourself and any previous experience with social media, sales, or lead generation.

title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications


Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.


Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager (Remote | Contract)


We’re looking for an experienced Project Manager to own delivery execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives in an agile engineering environment. This role sits at the center of business, product, and engineering — translating priorities into action, driving clarity, and ensuring work is delivered with quality and consistency.


This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and keeping teams aligned and moving.


What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives, from planning through execution and completion
  • Build and manage delivery plans, including scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and resource coordination
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to manage work intake, backlog grooming, prioritization, and task tracking (Jira)
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing clear updates and driving alignment across teams
  • Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and adjust plans as priorities evolve
  • Facilitate working sessions, stand-ups, planning meetings, and stakeholder workshops as needed
  • Support prioritization decisions by providing delivery insights, trade-offs, and impact analysis
  • Continuously improve delivery processes, tools, and ways of working to increase efficiency and predictability
  • Track and report on delivery progress using appropriate metrics and tools


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading delivery for complex projects or initiatives
  • Strong experience working in agile environments (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar)
  • Hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management and delivery tracking
  • Proven ability to work effectively with engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working in a client-facing role
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity
  • Experience supporting prioritization, change management, and delivery trade-offs
  • Basic SQL skills and familiarity with finance or accounting concepts are a plus, but not required

title: Sr. Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to join the Customer Identity (CI) team that is central to the enterprise, focused on ensuring customer data is accurate, consistent, and readily accessible. This critical data is the foundation for essential business processes, including personalized marketing, analytical reporting, and seamless online and in-store checkout and customer service experiences.


They manage a wide array of high-performance, scalable batch and real-time services. These services are utilized at numerous customer interactions, such as in-store purchases, online orders, rewards program enrollments, and activations from various marketing channels (Email, Direct Mail, SMS, Push notifications, etc.). By leveraging modern development practices, tools, and technology platforms, the CI team builds capabilities that empower customer-facing and checkout teams to deliver personalized, relevant, and frictionless experiences, ensuring customers realize value with every interaction.


Core hours:

This team operates in every major US time zone from Pacific to Eastern. Core hours would be considered 10 am CST - 4 pm CST with 2 hours spilling over either direction based on location.


Required Skills:

Non-Negotiable Requirements
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on full-stack engineering.
  • 4+ years of experience with Java, particularly Spring Boot.
  • 4+ years of mandatory experience with modern JavaScript and the React framework.
  • Direct experience using Kafka for event-driven architecture.
  • Experience with any relational database (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Oracle) for design and implementation.
  • Proven, hands-on experience in an XP/Agile environment, including daily Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Pair Programming.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
  • Excellent verbal communication skills —essential for a Pair Programming environment.
  • Experience with build management tools (Gradle or Maven) and GIT.


Tech Stack:  Java, Springboot, Redis, Relational Database (MySQL, Oracle), NoSQL Database (Mongo), Kafka, Cloud engineering (Docker/Kubernetes), Node.js, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, CSS, React, Angular, Testing framework (Junit, Jest).


Bonus Skills:

Experience with GCP suite (BigQuery), Airflow, and Web framework (Astro).


Duration:  3 months; end date being March 31, 2026, with the possibility of being extended based on team needs.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a leading retail innovator transforming the shopping experience through cutting-edge technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


Data Cloud Consultant

Skills:

It is desirable that the candidate has a Salesforce Certified Data Cloud Consultant certification, and should have experience in implementing and consulting on enterprise data platforms in a customer-facing role, including design, configuration, and solution architecture.


Recommendation:

Experience in implementing and working with strategy and data modeling, including building multiple solutions on Salesforce clouds.

- Have experience in development, strategy, business analysis, pre-sales solutions, or architecture.


Job Description:

Responsible for conducting customer discussions around requirements and technical drawing.

Development of software programs by technical specifications following programming standards and procedures, performing unit tests, performing program modifications and responding to problems by diagnosing and correcting logic and coding errors.

Ensure that secure coding and UI standards and best practices are applied during development.

Provide inputs and contribute to the improvement and maintenance of applications and programs.

Leading efforts to configure, analyze, design, develop, and maintain program code and applications.

Execution of detailed and complex unit tests and secure code testing and troubleshooting.

Conducting and supporting the source code management process.

Contributing to integration, systems and performance testing and code tuning.

Participation in secure code peer reviews.

Definition and promotion of opportunities for the reuse of code, configurations, procedures and techniques.


Requirements:

Degrees in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field are preferred.

Fluency in English to conduct technical meetings with offshore team, support teams and customers outside Brazil.

Experience with Data Architecture

Experience in writing SQL queries and data modeling, as well as governance and architecture performance practice and guidelines

Proficient in migrating data from traditional applications to Salesforce using the Import Wizard and Data Loader utility

Experienced in handling multi-country deployments and managing multiple instances of Salesforce.com

Experience with setting up and customizing managed Field Service packages is a plus.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs, and formulates models, diagrams, and documentation using IT processes, standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes, and tests data models, test scripts, and build scripts using IT processes, patterns, and tools, version control, and automation

Performance tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes, and resolves application, database, and hardware issues using IT processes, standards, and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance, and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item or solution change using the IT Operating Model (ITOM), including SDLC standards, tools, and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Customer Focus - Building strong customer relationships and providing customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity – Understanding complex, high-quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to solve problems effectively.

Global perspective – Take a broad view when addressing issues, using a global lens.

Action-oriented – Taking on new opportunities and difficult challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Optimizes work processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.


Skills:

Knowledge of service-oriented design (SOA) principles.

Excellent oral, presentation and written communication skills.

Good interpersonal skills.

Extensive knowledge of Salesforce technology and specifically the data cloud and its features and terminologies;

Experience in positioning and implementing Salesforce Data Cloud.

Salesforce Data Cloud certifications will be a plus for this role.

Proven experience in implementation and consulting of Salesforce Data Cloud environments.


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: LIDER DE OPERAÇÕES CL
description:
LIDER DE OPERAÇÕES CL


Descrição do Cargo:

Distribuir, treinar e orientar a equipe nas atividades operacionais dos setores de carregamento e transporte de peças e materiais, recebimento, expedição e gestão de estoques. Acompanhar a programação diária, avaliando a qualidade nas atividades executadas. Controlar e organizar as operações de produção de sua área, podendo intervir nas operações quando necessário no abastecimento de linha.


Função e Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar reuniões diárias com toda a equipe de trabalho, distribuindo as tarefas a serem realizadas, orientando e acompanhando o desenvolvimento na execução das tarefas, esclarecendo dúvidas quanto à execução das atividades, supervisionando os mesmos, a fim de atender as necessidades da empresa;
  • Verificar as prioridades do dia, observando os relatórios da operação e/ou produção e orientação da chefia, informando aos colaboradores dos mesmos, orientando na execução das tarefas, visando o pleno cumprimento das atividades da empresa;
  • Executar outras atividades inerentes e correlatas ao cargo.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior cursando, desejável superior completo
  • Pacote office - Excel, Powerpoint, WMS
  • CNH Categoria B Definitiva - desejável
  • Curso de Operação de Empilhadeiras - desejável
  • Disponibilidade de horário nos turnos abaixo:
  • Tarde: Segunda a sexta - 12h55 às 22h05 / Sábados alternados - 09h05 às 15h42;
  • Administrativo: Segunda a sexta – 08h00 às 17h15 - Sábados alternados.
  • Residir: em Santa Cruz Do Sul, Rio Pardo, Vera Cruz/RS.


O QUE OFERECEMOS?

Na CEVA Logistics, apoiamos e valorizamos a diversidade e não fazemos distinção de candidatos com deficiência, genêro, orientação sexual, raça/etnia ou idade. Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor, seguro, diverso e inclusivo, que incentiva a troca de conhecimentos e experiências, sempre com muito respeito às diferenças.


Com uma cultura sólida de reconhecimento e oportunidades internas, queremos que nossos colaboradores cresçam, se desenvolvam e façam parte de nossa jornada. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios competitivos do setor. title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centers, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.


Title- Sr .Net SQL Developer

Location- Brazil (Remote)

Type of Hire- Full Time


Senior Developer (.NET/SQL server/AWS)

  • Good in communication and client interaction
  • 10+ years of experience in .NET technologies: .NET core MVC, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Java Script, jQuery, Bootstrap, SSIS, Kendo, AWS
  • Knowledge on SSIS and Kendo is preferred.
  • Good working experience on DB – SQL and SQL server (Data analysis, writing complex queries, Stored procedures).
  • Good working experience in AWS cloud (like S3, RDS, Lamda, gateway, SQS) is preferred.
  • Participate in all the Scrum Ceremonies (Daily scrum, spring planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives)
  • Requirement gathering and analysis.
  • Story estimations and analysis
  • Performing UI and DB design
  • Coding and unit testing
  • UAT and production bug fixes
  • Deployment of code to Dev/STG
  • Participate in release calls and resolve the issues found.
  • Production support and resolve the issues found.
  • Performing Daily/weekly production monitoring jobs
  • Supporting the associate developers (requirement gathering, analysis, coding, testing and production support)
  • Daily Project Health monitoring.
  • Mortgage / Finance domain experience is a plus.
  • Experience in working with large applications with large volume transactions is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and unit testing activities
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP).
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of design patterns, refactoring, and unit testing
  • Experience with Linux and open-source software is a plus.
  • AWS Environment - EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, Containers, API Gateway experience highly preferred
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and QA activities (highly preferred)


Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Profissional .NET Sênior com Inglês
description:
Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Experiência com C# e .NET/Core;

- Domínio de bancos de dados Oracle e SQL Server, incluindo criação de procedures, views e otimização de consultas;

- Vivência com Windows Forms para manutenção e evolução de aplicações legadas;

- Desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful;

- Conhecimento sólido em programação orientada a objetos e aplicação de princípios SOLID;

- Prática com padrões de design (Design Patterns);

- Utilização de GIT para versionamento e controle de código-fonte;

- Conhecimento em frameworks front-end modernos, como React e Angular, desejável;

- Inglês intermediário ou avançado para leitura, escrita e conversação técnica;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Summary:


We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer (Azure Databricks) to design, implement, and optimize enterprise-grade data pipelines. In this role, you will leverage Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, and Python to enable scalable, governed, and performant data solutions. You will play a key role in modernizing our data platform on the Azure Cloud, ensuring reliability, efficiency, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.


Key Responsibilities:


·      Data Pipeline Development:  Design, build, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake) and Azure Data Factory (ADF).

·      Data Flows & Transformations:  Develop pipelines, data flows, and complex transformations with ADF, PySpark, and T-SQL for seamless data extraction, transformation, and loading.

·      Data Processing:  Develop Databricks Python notebooks for tasks such as joining, filtering, and pre-aggregation.

·      Database & Query Optimization:  Optimize database performance through SQL query tuning, index optimization, and code improvements to ensure efficient data retrieval and manipulation.

·      SSIS & Migration Support:  Maintain and enhance SSIS package design and deployment for legacy workloads; contribute to migration and modernization into cloud-native pipelines.

·      Collaboration & DevOps:  Work with cross-functional teams using Git (Azure Repos) for version control and Azure DevOps pipelines (CI/CD) for deployment.

·      Data Governance & Security : Partner with governance teams to integrate Microsoft Purview and Unity Catalog for cataloging, lineage tracking, and role-based security.

·      API & External Integration:  Implement REST APIs to retrieve analytics data from diverse external data feeds, enhancing accessibility and interoperability.

·      Automation:  Automate ETL processes and database maintenance tasks using SQL Agent Jobs, ensuring data integrity and operational reliability.

·      Advanced SQL Expertise:  Craft and optimize complex T-SQL queries to support efficient data processing and analytical workloads.


Required Califications:


·       5+ years of hands-on expertise with Azure Databricks, Python, PySpark, and Delta Lake.

·      5+ years of proven experience with Azure Data Factory for orchestrating and monitoring pipelines.

·      Strong SQL Server / T-SQL experience with a focus on query optimization, indexing strategies, and coding best practices.

·      Demonstrated experience in SSIS package design, deployment, and performance tuning.

·      Hands-on knowledge of Unity Catalog for governance.

·      Experience with Git (Azure DevOps Repos) and CI/CD practices in data engineering projects.


Nice to Have:


·       Exposure to Change Data Capture (CDC), Change Data Feed (CDF), and Temporal Tables.

·      Experience with Microsoft Purview, Power BI, and Azure-native integrations.

·      Familiarity with Profisee Master Data Management (MDM).

·      Working in Agile/Scrum environments.


Preferred Qualifications:


Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced Azure certification

Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional

  • Additional Microsoft SQL Server or Azure certifications demonstrating advanced database and cloud expertise

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: SDR – Soluções em Tecnologia e Cibersegurança
description:
O Grupo Ivy é um ecossistema completo de soluções de Tecnologia e Cibersegurança, atuando com projetos de alta complexidade, consultoria especializada, Outsourcing, SRE, desenvolvimento de software e um portfólio robusto de serviços em segurança digital, além de uma operação estruturada de revendas e distribuição de soluções corporativas.


Nossa unidade de cibersegurança entrega serviços como Pentest, Pentest Contínuo, Security Champion, Threat Modeling, Treinamentos, Gestão de Vulnerabilidades e Governança, incluindo produtos proprietários voltados à evolução contínua da maturidade em segurança, soluções orientadas a risco, escaláveis e integradas aos desafios reais dos ambientes modernos.


Sobre a Vaga

Buscamos um SDR para atuar na linha de frente comercial, responsável por gerar oportunidades qualificadas, realizar o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes e construir relacionamentos sólidos com decisores de tecnologia e segurança.

A pessoa ideal tem excelente comunicação, capacidade investigativa, boa desenvoltura ao telefone e experiência comercial no mercado Tech ou Cyber.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Remoto , com possíveis visitas presenciais a clientes quando necessário.
  • Formato de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado .


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar prospecção ativa (principalmente por telefone), com foco no ICP da empresa.
  • Conduzir o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes, apresentando a Ivy e entendendo o cenário atual.
  • Qualificar leads avaliando necessidades, dores, maturidade e momento de compra.
  • Manter rotina de acompanhamento e follow-up com leads em diferentes estágios.
  • Registrar informações no CRM, garantindo organização e clareza para o time de vendas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time comercial para priorização de contas e evolução do pipeline.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales, Pré-vendas ou função semelhante em empresas de tecnologia ou cibersegurança.
  • Boa comunicação verbal, especialmente para conversas por telefone.
  • Capacidade de investigação, escuta ativa e entendimento de problemas de tecnologia.
  • Organização para gerenciar conversas, prioridades e registros.
  • Facilidade em criar e manter relacionamentos profissionais.

Diferenciais

  • Vivência em consultorias de tecnologia ou segurança da informação.
  • Conhecimento geral do mercado de TI ou Cyber (infraestrutura, projetos, serviços, governança, segurança).
  • Experiência em vendas B2B.

Soft Skills

  • Comunicação clara
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Organização e consistência
  • Autonomia e proatividade


Se você se identifica com este perfil e deseja atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e com forte presença no mercado de tecnologia e cibersegurança, encorajamos você a se candidatar e construir sua trajetória junto ao Grupo Ivy .

title: Cloud Consultant
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Role: AWS Developer with SFMC

Location : Brazil



Ideal Experience:

  • Initiate new, and improve existing, systems processes
  • Hands-on development and coding as needed, serving as a senior developer and technical expert.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Participate/assist in development of deployment plans for the systems developed.
  • Perform other related duties as required and assigned
  • Demonstrate behaviors which are aligned with the organization’s desired culture and values
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying solutions on AWS.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure data integration pipelines between AWS services and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This includes using a variety of AWS services like AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon EventBridge, AWS AppFlow, and AWS Glue.
  • Develop processes for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) data between SFMC and data warehouses or data lakes hosted on AWS.
  • Work closely with marketing teams, Salesforce administrators, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Serve as a subject matter expert.
  • Specifically, experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, EC2) is highly desired.
  • Demonstrable experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with other systems, particularly AWS services
  • AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification is highly desirable. Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer or Email Specialist certification is a strong plus.




Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centres, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.



Role: AWS Developer with SFMC

Location : Brazil



Ideal Experience:

  • Initiate new, and improve existing, systems processes
  • Hands-on development and coding as needed, serving as a senior developer and technical expert.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Participate/assist in development of deployment plans for the systems developed.
  • Perform other related duties as required and assigned
  • Demonstrate behaviors which are aligned with the organization’s desired culture and values
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • At least 5+ years of hands-on experience developing and deploying solutions on AWS.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure data integration pipelines between AWS services and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This includes using a variety of AWS services like AWS Lambda, Amazon S3, Amazon EventBridge, AWS AppFlow, and AWS Glue.
  • Develop processes for extracting, transforming, and loading (ETL) data between SFMC and data warehouses or data lakes hosted on AWS.
  • Work closely with marketing teams, Salesforce administrators, and other developers to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Serve as a subject matter expert.
  • Specifically, experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, SQS, API Gateway, EC2) is highly desired.
  • Demonstrable experience integrating Salesforce Marketing Cloud with other systems, particularly AWS services
  • AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect certification is highly desirable. Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer or Email Specialist certification is a strong plus.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Field Support Engineer
description:
Location: Brazil | Supporting CALA

Company : Intellicene

Here’s the thing - This role sits right between deep technical work and real customer ownership. You’ll be hands-on with Intellicene’s software and hardware in the field, while also acting as a trusted advisor to customers across the CALA region.

What you’ll do

• Install, upgrade, troubleshoot, and maintain Intellicene’s enterprise software and related hardware

• Support video management, situational awareness, and dispatch solutions — onsite and remotely

• Own technical issues end-to-end and coordinate with internal teams to resolve them fast

• Travel to customer sites (up to 75%) for project deployment and delivering hands-on training

• Manage the customer lifecycle from onboarding to long-term success

• Drive product adoption through training, usage analysis, and practical guidance

• Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives

• Identify upsell and expansion opportunities and work closely with Sales

What you bring

• Fluent Portuguese, Spanish, and English

• Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience

• Experience in physical security/video surveillance environments

• Strong background supporting enterprise software in LAN/WAN environments

• Solid networking knowledge (TCP/IP, LAN/WAN, Multicast)

• Experience with Windows Server, virtualization, MS SQL Server, and hardware (RAID, NAS/SAN)

• Customer-facing mindset with clear communication and presentation skills

• Experience with tools like Salesforce, Zoho, Aha, and Microsoft 365

• Willingness to travel frequently and handle shifting priorities

Nice to have

• 5+ years in customer-facing technical roles (support, professional services, pre/post-sales)

• Relevant certifications (Cisco, MCSE, Project Management)

• Experience reading SOWs and presenting to executive audiences

If you enjoy being close to the technology and even closer to the customer, this role is for you.

title: Senior C#/.NET Full-Stack DBA Developer
description:
This position requires fluent English - do not apply with a non-English profile/resume as it will be automatically filtered.


Position Overview  


We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Developer with deep database ownership experience  to join our growing engineering team. This role is intentionally hybrid: you will design and build software  while also owning the reliability, performance, scalability, and cost management of our SQL databases . 


This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is database-centric but not database-only —someone who enjoys writing production code, building features that interact heavily with data, and taking responsibility for how the database performs in real-world, high-availability environments. 


You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

You will work across application code, database architecture, and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership to deliver scalable, reliable systems. 


Key Responsibilities  


Database Architecture, Performance & Ownership  

  • Design, evolve, and optimize database schemas, indexes, queries, and stored procedures  to support high-performance application workloads 
  • Own database performance tuning , query optimization, and capacity planning across environments 
  • Manage availability, backup/restore, disaster recovery, and survivability  strategies in Azure SQL 
  • Monitor and proactively address performance bottlenecks, deadlocks, blocking, and resource contention  
  • Own database cost management  in Azure, including sizing, scaling strategies, and cost optimization 
  • Ensure data integrity, security, and operational excellence  throughout the application lifecycle 


Software Development & Feature Delivery  

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services  using C# and .NET 
  • Build application features that interact deeply with the database , balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability 
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs  and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems 
  • Participate in architectural discussions  and influence technical direction across the stack 
  • Perform code reviews  and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development 
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers 


Azure Cloud & DevOps  

  • Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure , with a focus on reliability and observability 
  • Support CI/CD pipelines  and deployment practices using Azure DevOps 
  • Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution 
  • Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost 


Required Qualifications  


Experience & Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience 
  • 7+ years  of professional experience in C#/.NET software development 
  • Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) 


Technical Skills (Priority Order)  

  • Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL expertise , including: 

Advanced T-SQL 

Stored procedures and query optimization 

Indexing strategies and execution plan analysis 

Performance tuning and troubleshooting 

  • Proven experience owning database operations , including: 

Backup, restore, high availability, and disaster recovery 

Performance monitoring and scaling 

Cost and capacity management in Azure 

  • Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  
  • Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs  
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services , including App Services, Functions, and Storage
  • Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum  development methodologies 
  • Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps  

Soft Skills  

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities 
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems 
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability 
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams 

Bonus Points  

  • Microsoft Azure certifications (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect, or similar) 
  • Experience with Plivo or Twilio  
  • Experience with message-based systems  (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.) 
  • Strong understanding of DevOps practices  and production operations 
  • Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments  

What We Offer  

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience 
  • Opportunity to own critical systems  and influence architectural decisions 
  • A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement
